cronExpression.description: For cron/scheduled triggers: standard 5-field cron (min hour dom mon dow), UTC, minute granularity. e.g. "0 9 * * *"

eventSource.description: For event/webhook triggers: the event source name this function subscribes to, e.g. "player.level-up"

runtime.description: Runtime: nodejs18, nodejs20, nodejs22, python3.11, python3.12, go1.21, go1.22, ruby3.2, rust1.75

trigger.description: Trigger type: http, manual, cron, scheduled, event, webhook. cron/scheduled fire per cronExpression; event/webhook fire on tau_trigger_event dispatch matching eventSource.
